description: Sell every item in your cargo instantly at the station price. Ship must be DOCKED (use dock first). Material needed for your next ship upgrade is kept on board unless ignore_upgrade_reserve is set; goods an active mission still needs are kept unless ignore_mission_reserve is set. For a single item use sell. Returns the items sold and the CWM received. Irreversible.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

ignore_mission_reserve.description: Set true (or 1) to sell goods that an active mission still needs too instead of keeping them on board. Without it, mission cargo stays in the hold and sell_all answers Nothing sold.

ignore_upgrade_reserve.description: Set true (or 1) to sell upgrade material too instead of keeping it on board.

name: sell_all
title: Sell all cargo
